_status: DRAFT (scripts/transfer_criteria.py). Binding only once committed by the PI at G5, before any set-B prediction (DESIGN v3 §7.6). Thresholds derived from anchors, controls and observed-vs-observed replicate agreement only; no model has been applied to set A or set B.

decisions.D7: set-A/B skill = mean over the per-fold (5 dev CV) frozen models; it is matched against anchor skill computed with single out-of-fold (OOF) anchor predictions (each anchor line predicted by the fold model that did not train on it)
decisions.D10: harmonised effects on the DepMap-matched affine scale (configs/harmonisation_frozen.json)
decisions.D12: no gene-wise correction for Yilmaz 2018; Wang-library anchors are not a same-pipeline anchor for it -> its verdicts are 'inconclusive' only

labels.evaluable_genes: eval_genes_external: genes scored in the screen and in the model output
labels.rpe1_cegv2_sensitivity: RPE1 results also reported without CEGv2 genes (CEGv2 partly derives from RPE1)

Q3a.primary_reported: absolute AUPRC of model T per screen and per label, reported relative to the replicate ceiling of its background (ratio AUPRC_T / ceiling AUPRC)
Q3a.verdict_statistic: skill = AUPRC(T) - AUPRC(B0) (per-gene dev mean), per screen; background skill = mean over the background's evaluable screens; CI from the gene-block bootstrap
secondary: AUPRC/AUROC of T and of the full model vs B0, B1, B2

Q3b.screen_specific: observed harmonised effect < -0.5 AND DepMap dev dependency fraction <= 0.5 (configs/gene_classes.csv frac_below); secondary: fraction <= 0.05
Q3b.verdict_statistic: skill = recall(T) - recall(B1) at the threshold giving 5% FPR on the NEGv1 EVALUATION half (configs/control_split.json neg_evaluation); also reported vs B0 (and B2); Clopper-Pearson CIs per screen; background skill = mean over evaluable screens with a gene-block bootstrap CI
Q3b.secondary: deviation correlation over selective + rare-selective genes

bootstrap.scheme: gene-block bootstrap; blocks = paralog families = connected components of cache/priors/paralog_pairs.parquet pairs with min(identity, rev_identity) >= 30%; unpaired genes are singleton blocks

verdicts.transfers: lower 95% CI bound of background skill over B0 (Q3a) or B1 (Q3b) > 0 AND skill >= 50% of the same-pipeline anchor skill (same lab/library anchors through the same harmonisation, D7 OOF)
verdicts.fails: ALL of: (1) skill <= 0 (point estimate not above the B0/B1 comparator); (2) upper 95% CI bound of skill < MDE of the background; (3) same-pipeline anchors show positive skill (lower CI > 0); (4) harmonisation validation passed for the screens (QC pass, configs/screen_plan.csv)
verdicts.inconclusive: otherwise, and always when a screen has no same-pipeline anchor or no replicate ceiling
verdicts.expression_swap_cap: profile-swap null: each screen is also predicted from other screens' expression profiles; matched must beat mismatched. If the swapped-profile skill has a lower 95% CI bound > 0, the verdict for that background is capped at 'inconclusive'
verdicts.nearest_lineage_comparator: B1 prediction for the closest cancer lineage is reported alongside
verdicts.overall: per question, 'transfers' if a strict majority of EVALUABLE backgrounds transfer; 'fails' if a strict majority fail; otherwise 'inconclusive'. With the two evaluable backgrounds (RPE1, hPSC) this means both must agree

primary_T.reason: Shifrut 2018 (SSMD -0.81) and Carnevale 2022 ORCS (-0.79) fail QC; Ting 2018 CD4 passes but covers ~2.5k genes with no same-pipeline anchor and no replicate ceiling

HMEC.reason: Tuano 2023 targeted libraries contain 2 NEGv1 evaluation genes (QC not assessable); Sack 2018 scores have unknown direction

other.screens: fetal NSC (ORCS 572/573/1030/1031), MCF-10A (2086/2087), HUDEP-2 (2443), intestinal organoid (2485/2486)

screen_level_notes.hPSC: Ihry 2019 (Novartis, no anchor) and Yilmaz 2018 (D12) are 'inconclusive only'; Mair 2019 (TKOv3, anchor HAP1: weak, single anchor) is the only hPSC screen that can reach transfers/fails

H1.criterion: within-screen percentile rank (low = more depleted) of the PREDICTED effect of MDM2 and of PPM1D is lower in TP53-WT backgrounds (RPE1 WT screens, hPSC) than in the TP53-null RPE1 screens, for BOTH genes (difference of mean percentiles < 0; gene-block bootstrap not applicable to 2 genes: screen-level permutation p < 0.05 across WT vs null screens)

H1_prime.statistic: observed positive effects in TP53-WT screens vs the cancer range (descriptive)

H2.criterion: model's WT - null delta (TP53 genotype feature flipped, same expression input) vs the observed WT - null delta over the 15 p53/DDR genes of configs/harmonisation_frozen.json: pass if sign agreement >= 70% over genes with |observed delta| > 0.25 AND Pearson r > 0.3

observed_pairs.primary: Bowden 2020 isogenic WT vs KO (custom DDR library)
observed_pairs.secondary: Brown 2019 PACE002 T18 (WT, TKOv3) vs Olivieri 2020 TKOv3 NT mean (TP53-/-, TKOv3); Haapaniemi WT fails QC

H3.criterion: in hPSC screens, predicted effect < -0.5 for >= half of the set with the 7 germ-cell/EC lines in training; if this holds only with EC lines present (fewer than half without), the claim is 'narrow EC transfer'
H3.observed_check: observed hPSC effects for the set are reported descriptively

H4.reason: primary T-cell screens fail QC (Shifrut SSMD -0.81); CD34+ (Ting) is a marker sort; SPI1 sits in the descriptive microglia CRISPRi stratum

negative_controls: CN null: SMARCA2, ARID1B, STAG1, ME2/ME3, ENO1 ~0 in prediction and observation
